title: The Discourses of Epictetus
blurb: A freed slave's lectures on what is and is not in your power, written down by a student. The manual the Stoics actually used.

rights.basis: author d. 135; first published 108 — public domain in India (life + 60) and the United States (pre-1930); translation by George Long (d. 1879), first published 1877 — public domain in India (life + 60) and the United States (pre-1930)

translator.name: George Long
translator.source: already recorded on the shelved Meditations record; Long's Epictetus and Marcus Aurelius were published by Bell & Daldy in the 1860s–70s
